strategy: The robot will navigate toward the goal location while avoiding obstacles and stopping safely when necessary.
decisions: If the goal is ahead and FORWARD is clear, move FORWARD.
If the goal is to the left and LEFT is clear, move LEFT.
If the goal is to the right and RIGHT is clear, move RIGHT.
If no clear goal direction is available, prioritize FORWARD, then LEFT, then RIGHT.
If all directions are blocked, STOP.
stop_condition: If all movement directions are blocked, the robot must STOP.
